essence: Knowledge of baṭuka offerings enables kula actions.
Knowing the time of enjoyment, one should receive śakti.
Knowing acceptance of the three principles, one drinks kula nectar.
Knowing yoginī enjoyment and related conduct makes one a kaulika.
Knowing peaceful hymn recitation and related practice, one may be a kula teacher.
